caption: The drawing depicts a small, ornate vessel with a single handle on the right side, rendered predominantly in a deep purple color with some highlights and shading to indicate shine and curvature. The body of the vessel features raised decorative patterns, including swirling lines, dots, and a diamond shape, all in the same purple hue. The vessel has a short, circular neck and a metallic-looking, brassy cap or collar. Emerging from the top of the vessel are two cylindrical objects, each topped with white, feathery or brush-like tips. The background is plain and cream-colored, bordered by a simple, thin rectangular outline. The artist's signature, "John Tarantino," appears in the lower right corner of the inner rectangle.
title: Lamp
